newsitem.title: UK: Colombia tenders to sell raw sugar for September.
newsitem.headline: Colombia tenders to sell raw sugar for September.

text.p: Colombia has tendered to sell two cargoes of raw sugar for September shipment dates, traders said on Thursday.
The tonnage of the first cargo was between 20,000 and 25,000 tonnes, for 5/15 September, and the second for between 10,000 and 15,000 tonnes, for 10/20 September, they said.
"Some of this is quota sugar and some is for re-export but the exact figures have yet to be determined," said one trader.
The deadline for bids to be received has yet to emerge.
